import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, uuid
NL, F = chr(10), chr(96) * 4
R = pathlib.Path.cwd()
src = (R / 'scripts/plan_extract.py').read_text()
assert 'subprocess' not in src and 'os.system' not in src and 'uuid.UUID(' not in src, 'plan_extract runs nothing and checks run ids only through run_id.py'
own = json.loads((R / 'harness-manifest.json').read_text())['ownership']
assert [own[k].count('scripts/plan_extract.py') for k in ('install_payload_paths', 'update_paths')] == [1, 1], 'manifest'
T, L, E = (pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve() for _ in range(3))
mission = T / 'docs/missions/fx'
tasks = mission / 'tasks'
tasks.mkdir(parents=True)
(mission / 'GOAL.md').write_text('# Goal' + NL)
def task(tid, body='Body.'):
    return NL.join(['---', 'task_id: ' + tid, 'feature: F001', '---', '', '# Task ' + tid, '', body])
def fence(text, info='markdown'):
    return NL.join([F + info, text, F])
def filed(path, text):
    return NL.join(['=== FILE: ' + path + ' ===', text, '=== END FILE ==='])
def cli(arg, out):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(R / 'scripts/plan_extract.py'), arg, str(out)], cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
def run(final, out=tasks, header=''):
    log = L / (str(uuid.uuid4()) + '.log')
    log.write_text(header + json.dumps({'type': 'result', 'result': final}) + NL)
    return cli(str(log), out)
def tree():
    return sorted(os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(T) for f in fs)
decoy = 'spawn-brain: action=plan' + NL + 'prompt: ' + fence(task('T-999')) + NL + '----' + NL
r = run(NL.join(['Plan follows.', fence(task('T-901')), '', filed('docs/missions/fx/tasks/T-902.md', task('T-902')), '', fence('{}', 'json'), 'Done.']), header=decoy)
assert (r.returncode, r.stdout) == (0, 'T-901' + NL + 'T-902' + NL), (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
assert [(tasks / n).read_text() for n in ('T-901.md', 'T-902.md')] == [task('T-901') + NL, task('T-902') + NL]
assert sorted(p.name for p in tasks.iterdir()) == ['T-901.md', 'T-902.md'], sorted(tasks.iterdir())
(tasks / 'link').symlink_to(E)
def refused(final, out=tasks):
    before = tree()
    x = run(final, out)
    assert x.returncode != 0 and x.stdout == '' and x.stderr.startswith('plan_extract: '), (final, x.returncode, x.stdout, x.stderr)
    assert tree() == before and list(E.iterdir()) == [], final
refused(filed('docs/missions/fx/../../../evil.md', task('T-910')))
refused(filed('docs/missions/fx/tasks/../../other/T-911.md', task('T-911')))
refused(filed(str(tasks / 'T-912.md'), task('T-912')))
refused(filed('docs/missions/fx/tasks/link/T-913.md', task('T-913')))
refused(filed('docs/missions/fx/features.json', task('T-914')))
refused(fence(NL.join(['---', 'feature: F001', '---', '# No id'])))
refused(fence(task('../T-915')))
refused(NL.join([fence(task('T-916')), filed('docs/missions/fx/tasks/T-916-copy.md', task('T-916'))]))
refused(fence(task('T-901', 'changed')))
refused(F + NL + task('T-917'))
refused('No task blocks here.')
refused(fence(task('T-918')), mission)
(tasks / 'link').unlink()
rid = str(uuid.uuid4())
(T / '.tasks/logs').mkdir(parents=True)
(T / '.tasks/logs' / (rid + '.log')).write_text(json.dumps({'event': 'result', 'result': {'response': fence(task('T-920'))}}) + NL)
r = cli(rid, tasks)
assert (r.returncode, r.stdout) == (0, 'T-920' + NL) and (tasks / 'T-920.md').read_text() == task('T-920') + NL, (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
print('ok')
git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 sh -c 'python3 -m json.tool "$1" >/dev/null' sh
